items.source: Interface used to indicate that a bean should run when it is contained within a SpringApplication.
items.translation: 用于指示当 Bean 包含在SpringApplication中时应运行的接口。

items.source: Strategy interface for creating the ConfigurableApplicationContext used by a SpringApplication.
items.translation: 用于创建由 SpringApplication 使用的 ConfigurableApplicationContext 的策略接口。

items.source: BeanFactoryPostProcessor to set lazy-init on bean definitions that are not excluded and have not already had a value explicitly set.
items.translation: BeanFactoryPostProcessor 来为未被excluded且尚未显式设置值的 Bean 定义设置懒加载初始化。

items.source: Filter that can be used to exclude beans definitions from having their lazy-init set by the LazyInitializationBeanFactoryPostProcessor.
items.translation: 可用于排除 bean 定义，使其不被 lazy-init 由 LazyInitializationBeanFactoryPostProcessor 设置的过滤器。

items.source: Provides access to details of a SpringApplication run using SpringApplication.Augmented.run(String...).
items.translation: 提供对使用 SpringApplication.Augmented.run(String...) 运行的 SpringApplication 的详细信息。

items.source: Low-level hook that can be used to attach a SpringApplicationRunListener to a SpringApplication in order to observe or modify its behavior.
items.translation: 低级钩子，可用于将 SpringApplicationRunListener 附加到 SpringApplication，以观察或修改其行为。

items.source: Listener for the SpringApplication run method.
items.translation: 监听SpringApplication的run方法。

items.source: Interface used to generate an 'exit code' from a running command line SpringApplication.
items.translation: 用于从运行的命令行生成“退出码”的接口 SpringApplication。

items.source: Exception that can be thrown to silently exit a running SpringApplication without handling run failures.
items.translation: 可抛出以静默退出正在运行的SpringApplication而无需处理运行失败的异常。

items.source: Used to configure and run an augmented SpringApplication where additional configuration should be applied.
items.translation: 用于配置和运行增强的SpringApplication，以便应用额外的配置。

items.source: Entry point for AOT processing of a SpringApplication.
items.translation: AOT 处理SpringApplication的入口点。

items.source: Callback interface used to support custom reporting of SpringApplication startup errors.
items.translation: 用于支持自定义报告SpringApplication启动错误的回调接口。

items.source: Provides access to the arguments that were used to run a SpringApplication.
items.translation: 提供对用于运行 SpringApplication 的参数的访问权限。

items.source: Default implementation of ApplicationArguments.
items.translation: `ApplicationArguments` 接口的默认实现。

items.source: Allows for customization of the application's Environment prior to the application context being refreshed.
items.translation: 允许在刷新应用程序上下文之前自定义应用程序的 Environment。

items.source: Event fired when an application exit code has been determined from an ExitCodeGenerator.
items.translation: 当应用程序的退出码由 ExitCodeGenerator 确定时触发的事件。

items.source: Banner implementation that prints from a source text Resource.
items.translation: 从 Resource 源文本打印的 Banner 实现。

items.source: Indicates that a class provides Spring Boot application @Configuration.
items.translation: 表示该类提供了 Spring Boot 应用程序的@Configuration。

items.source: Core Spring Boot classes.
items.translation: 核心 Spring Boot 类。

items.source: Exception thrown when the AOT initializer couldn't be found.
items.translation: AOT 初始化器找不到时抛出异常。

items.source: Interface class for writing a banner programmatically.
items.translation: 用于通过编程方式编写横幅的接口类。

items.source: An enumeration of possible values for configuring the Banner.
items.translation: 配置 Banner 的可能值的枚举。

items.source:
Strategy interface that can be used to provide a mapping between exceptions and exit
codes.
items.translation: 可用于提供异常与退出码之间映射的策略接口。

items.source:
Class that can be used to bootstrap and launch a Spring application from a Java main
method.
items.translation: 可用于从 Java 主方法引导和启动 Spring 应用程序的类。

items.source:
Interface that can be used to add or remove code that should run when the JVM is
shutdown.
items.translation: 可用于添加或移除在 JVM 关闭时应运行的代码的接口。

items.source: Exposes the Spring Boot version.
items.translation: 显示 Spring Boot 版本。

items.source: An enumeration of possible types of web application.
items.translation: 一种可能的 Web 应用程序类型的枚举。
